en: • Innovator exclusive MS “Galazzo” Hilling Care aircraft has been converted into HGKit
• Reproduce the setting color of Hilling machine with molding color
• Reproduces characteristic equipment such as the beam claw that generates a beam from the fingertips and the GN field generator that slides out.
• Can be displayed using the included dedicated pedestal
